name: Lock ray
summary: Raycasting in two phases: lock the ray on a set of candidates, then move a cursor along it to pick one.
howItWorks: After pointing, the ray is locked in place and the user moves a depth marker along it to the intended target among those it intersects.

review.notes: Checked against Grossman & Balakrishnan (UIST 2006) in Oct 2026: evaluated on a volumetric display with targets within arm's reach, using a tracked one-button handheld device.
